snippet.title: Assault on Hartblood Hotel - Your party members gain a new curse every 10 seconds!
snippet.description:
Play for free https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/51/assault-on-hartblood-hotel Three assassins from an underground syndicate raise hell inside the Hartblood Hotel. Their mission: To huntdown the owner. Follow orders as given. Do not question authority.

A timer has been set for you to die over and over. Every 10 seconds, a new curse to bear. Don’t get sloppy now; it’s bad for the skin.

Kill everyone as fast as you can and avoid the burden of The Seal.

And may God have mercy on their souls.
